payload.label: What the council owes
payload.note: The council's own estimate of what it owed outside lenders at the end of 2025/26, against an operational boundary of £314.4m and a legal ceiling of £344.4m, both set by full Council. Most of what the council needs to borrow for is council housing: of a total capital financing requirement of £314.4m, £208.5m is the Housing Revenue Account's, about £14,674 per council home, repaid from rents. The strategy plans about £42m of new borrowing during 2026/27.
